# Non-rooted devices

frida-server needs root because attaching to another app requires ptrace
privileges. On a phone that is not rooted, put the agent *inside* the app:
frida-gadget, a shared library the app loads, which opens a listening port.

The emulator lab still uses the original package with frida-server. The
gadget APK has the same package name, built for the phone ABI.

## 1. Install the prebuilt gadget APK

Download the gadget-embedded minapp from <https://t.me/rzfrida/27>. If an
emulator is also connected, target the phone (`adb -s <serial>` or
`adb -d`) so this APK is not installed on the emulator.

```bash
$ adb uninstall re.frida.minapp
$ adb install -r minapp.apk
$ adb shell am start -n re.frida.minapp/.MainActivity
$ adb logcat -d | grep Frida
I Frida : Listening on 127.0.0.1 TCP port 27042
```

The gadget registers itself as a process named `Gadget`. In the default
`on_load: wait` mode the app **pauses** until a client attaches: a blank
screen and an `am start -W` timeout are normal.

## 2. Attach

```bash
$ frida-ps -U | grep Gadget
12345  Gadget
```

If more than one USB device is connected, pin the phone:

```bash
$ adb devices -l
$ frida-ps -D <serial> | grep Gadget
```

![The gadget process](img/remote_access/gadget-process.png)

```text
[0x00000000]> Froj frida://attach/usb//Gadget
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"attach","pid":12345,"resumed":false,"state":"attached"}}
```

Or with the device serial in the URI:

```text
[0x00000000]> Froj frida://attach/usb/<serial>/Gadget
```

Attaching also resumes a paused app.

If USB discovery does not list `Gadget`, forward the listen port and use
the remote URI (the same port the gadget prints in logcat):

```bash
$ adb forward tcp:27042 tcp:27042
```

```text
[0x00000000]> Froj frida://attach/remote/127.0.0.1:27042/Gadget
```

When another device already occupies host port 27042, pick a free host
port (`adb forward tcp:27043 tcp:27042`) and attach to `127.0.0.1:27043`.

## What spawn cannot do

Spawn needs to start the process under frida's control, which requires
ptrace. Without root, spawn is not available. Attach to `Gadget`:

| Operation | Rooted (frida-server) | Non-rooted (gadget) |
|---|---|---|
| attach | yes | yes |
| spawn | yes | no |
| launch | yes | no |
| RegisterNatives at spawn | yes | attach, then later loads |

> **Note:** with `on_load: wait`, startup registrations happen after you
> attach, so a RegisterNatives hook armed right after attach can still
> catch them.

## Optional: embed a gadget in your own app

The prebuilt gadget APK at <https://t.me/rzfrida/27> is enough for this
chapter. For a different app on a phone that is not rooted, embed
`libfrida-gadget.so` in that app (same version as the plugin's
frida-core) and load it at startup. `scripts/fetch_frida_gadget.py`
downloads the `.so`. Then attach to the process named `Gadget` as above.
